FIIS NET BUYERS AT ₹10,308.42 CRORE ON 20 NOV

On 20 November 2026, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net buyers of ₹10,308.42 crore in the cash market, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net sellers of ₹4,859.80 crore.

November so far (5 sessions): FIIs +32,646.67 crore, DIIs -12,698.39 crore.
